name: Ling-3.0-flash
attention_variant: hybrid: MLA (kv_lora_rank 512) + Kimi Delta Attention, 5:1 alternating, 20 window layers
notes: Vendor: 124B total / 5.1B active; safetensors total 127.49B. Card calls it a 'native hybrid linear attention' model, hybrid from the start of pretraining rather than retrofit. The pattern is KDA + MLA, which makes it architecturally a sibling of Kimi Linear: config (model_type bailing_hybrid) has kv_lora_rank 512, qk_nope_head_dim 128, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, qk_head_dim 192, plus max_window_layers 20 and layer_group_size 6, short_conv_kernel_size 4, kda_lower_bound -5.0, kda_safe_gate true. The card states 5:1 alternating stacking of KDA and MLA. kv_cache_bytes_per_token = 20 full-attention layers x (kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64) x 2 bytes = 20 x 576 x 2 = 23,040 B/token (22.5 KiB). Note 20 is max_window_layers, and the config does NOT enumerate which layers are full vs linear the way Kimi Linear's linear_attn_config does - the 5:1 ratio over 42 layers is the source for the split, so this derivation is the least certain of the hybrid records. Treat the layer count as approximate. At 5.1B active and 22.5 KiB/token this is one of the cheapest long-context configurations in the slice: ~2.75 GiB of KV at 128k. MoE: 512 routed + 1 shared expert (moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size 768), 8 per token, first_k_dense_replace 2, moe_intermediate_size 768, topk_method noaux_tc with n_group 8 / topk_group 4. hidden 2560, intermediate 6144. Context 262144, rope_theta 6000000, partial_rotary_factor 0.5, rope_interleave true. MIT.
